points.heading: Number and place value
points.summary: Count to and across 100, count objects, find one more and one less, and count in 2s, 5s and 10s.

points.heading: Addition and subtraction
points.summary: Know number bonds within 20, and add and subtract one-digit and two-digit numbers to 20, including zero.

points.heading: Multiplication and division
points.summary: Solve one-step multiplication and division problems with objects, pictures and arrays.

points.heading: Fractions
points.summary: Recognise, find and name a half and a quarter of an object, shape or quantity.

points.heading: Measurement
points.summary: Compare, describe and measure lengths and heights, and tell the time to the hour and half past.

points.heading: Geometry: properties of shapes
points.summary: Recognise and name common 2-D and 3-D shapes.

points.heading: Geometry: position and direction
points.summary: Describe position, direction and movement, including whole, half, quarter and three-quarter turns.

points.heading: Number and place value
points.summary: Count in steps of 2, 3, 5 and 10, and know the place value of each digit in a two-digit number.

points.heading: Addition and subtraction
points.summary: Recall facts to 20 fluently, and add and subtract two-digit numbers and ones.

points.heading: Multiplication and division
points.summary: Recall and use multiplication and division facts for the 2, 5 and 10 times tables.

points.heading: Fractions
points.summary: Recognise, find, name and write 1/3, 1/4, 2/4 and 3/4 of a length, shape or set of objects.

points.heading: Measurement
points.summary: Measure length in centimetres, and tell the time to five minutes.

points.heading: Geometry: properties of shapes
points.summary: Describe the properties of 2-D and 3-D shapes, including their edges, vertices and faces.

points.heading: Geometry: position and direction
points.summary: Use mathematical words for position and movement, including clockwise and anticlockwise right-angle turns.

points.heading: Statistics
points.summary: Interpret and construct pictograms, tally charts, block diagrams and tables.

points.heading: Number and place value
points.summary: Count in multiples of 4, 8, 50 and 100, find 10 or 100 more or less, and know the place value of each digit in a three-digit number.

points.heading: Addition and subtraction
points.summary: Add and subtract numbers with up to three digits, using formal written methods of columnar addition and subtraction.

points.heading: Multiplication and division
points.summary: Recall and use multiplication and division facts for the 3, 4 and 8 times tables.

points.heading: Fractions
points.summary: Recognise and use unit and non-unit fractions, and equivalent fractions with small denominators.

points.heading: Measurement
points.summary: Measure lengths in millimetres, and tell the time to the minute, including from Roman numerals.

points.heading: Geometry: properties of shapes
points.summary: Recognise right angles, and identify horizontal, vertical, perpendicular and parallel lines.

points.heading: Statistics
points.summary: Interpret and present data using bar charts, pictograms and tables.

points.heading: Number and place value
points.summary: Count in multiples of 6, 7, 9, 25 and 1,000, count back through zero, and know the place value of each digit in a four-digit number.

points.heading: Addition and subtraction
points.summary: Add and subtract numbers with up to four digits, using formal written methods of columnar addition and subtraction.

points.heading: Multiplication and division
points.summary: Recall multiplication and division facts for times tables up to 12 × 12.

points.heading: Fractions (including decimals)
points.summary: Recognise families of equivalent fractions, and write tenths and hundredths as decimals.

points.heading: Measurement
points.summary: Find the perimeter of rectilinear shapes, and convert between the 12-hour and 24-hour clock.

points.heading: Geometry: properties of shapes
points.summary: Compare and classify geometric shapes, including quadrilaterals and triangles.

points.heading: Geometry: position and direction
points.summary: Describe positions on a 2-D grid as coordinates in the first quadrant, and describe translations.

points.heading: Statistics
points.summary: Interpret and present discrete and continuous data using bar charts and time graphs.

points.heading: Number and place value
points.summary: Read, write and order numbers to 1,000,000, count in powers of 10, and know the value of each digit in a decimal.

points.heading: Addition and subtraction
points.summary: Add and subtract whole numbers and decimals, using formal written methods.

points.heading: Multiplication and division
points.summary: Multiply and divide by 10, 100 and 1,000, and recognise square and cube numbers.

points.heading: Fractions (including decimals and percentages)
points.summary: Connect fractions, decimals and percentages, and compare and order them.

points.heading: Measurement
points.summary: Calculate the area of rectangles, and solve problems involving time.

points.heading: Geometry: properties of shapes
points.summary: Distinguish between regular and irregular polygons from their sides and angles.

points.heading: Geometry: position and direction
points.summary: Identify, describe and represent the position of a shape after a reflection or translation.

points.heading: Statistics
points.summary: Solve problems using information presented in line graphs, tables and timetables.

points.heading: Number and place value
points.summary: Read, write, order and compare numbers up to 10,000,000, and use negative numbers in context.

points.heading: Addition, subtraction, multiplication and division
points.summary: Solve multi-step problems with large numbers, using the order of operations.

points.heading: Fractions (including decimals and percentages)
points.summary: Use equivalence between fractions, decimals and percentages, including decimal equivalents such as 3/8.

points.heading: Ratio and proportion
points.summary: Solve problems involving relative sizes, scale factors and unequal sharing.

points.heading: Algebra
points.summary: Generate and describe linear number sequences, and use simple formulae.

points.heading: Measurement
points.summary: Calculate the volume of cuboids, and convert between units of time.

points.heading: Geometry: properties of shapes
points.summary: Recognise, describe and build simple 3-D shapes, including making nets.

points.heading: Geometry: position and direction
points.summary: Describe positions on the full coordinate grid, in all four quadrants.

points.heading: Statistics
points.summary: Interpret and construct pie charts and line graphs, and calculate the mean as an average.
